summary: Satya, co-host and co-creator of the podcast Melanin Millennials, revealed that the Shout Out Network (SON) removed her from the show without consent, denied her ownership rights, and claimed ownership of the podcast's trademark without prior agreement. She stated that SON began this process on September 15, 2016, and that she was not informed of their actions until after the show's initial launch, despite having a verbal agreement that all content created by her and M.R.A.L. Morgan was theirs. Satya expressed her intent to reclaim ownership of the content and thanked listeners for their support during the podcast's run.
